_meta.title: Grid video (beat-synced grid music video)
_meta.description: One source clip or still + a music track -> a beat-synced grid music video (poster grid, style infection or temporal mosaic). No models: a single CJGridVideo node (comfy_nodes/cj_h3_tools/cj_grid_video.py, numpy + ffmpeg) renders the plan the builder (src/lib/oj/gridVideo.ts) computes from the beats and muxes the music as the soundtrack (H.264 + AAC MP4).
